review:
A mad scientist, his sidekick Mr. Brain and a monster loose in Electric City, on 5x4 paylines. EyeBall symbols only land on the bottom row, and once the grid settles each one fires up or diagonally, turning every paying symbol in its path wild – sometimes with a multiplier.

Hitting a wild gives it a multiplier, and hitting one that already has a multiplier adds more, so overlapping beams are what you want. The bonuses bring more EyeBalls or make each one fire two ways. Medium volatility, 10,000x max, 96% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.00% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
